apple:874139669.releaseNotes: • In addition to the existing remote backup support, this update introduces a new on-device backup option too. Now you can export an encrypted copy of your Signal messages and save them to the storage location of your choice.
• We added a convenient shortcut to quickly lower your hand after you start speaking during a Signal group call. It's hands down our favorite feature in this release.

• Now you can link another iPhone to your Signal account to send and receive messages and stay in sync with your main phone. Previously only iPads and laptops were supported as linked devices, but after this update one pocket no longer needs to be jealous of the other.

• Introducing disappearing call events: Missed, outgoing, and received calls that occur after you install this update will now automatically disappear in any chat where disappearing messages are enabled.

Ending a group prevents group members from sending messages or starting calls, and also disables invites. Now you can make sure everyone stays on the right thread by ending last year's sewing meetup group before stitching a new one together.

- Built-in VPN: Get 50 GB of protected browsing each month to help hide your IP address and location. Available in select countries, with more coming soon.
- Better media controls: Skip forward or back and use the timeline to find your spot right from the media notification.
- Android sharing: On Android 14 and later, sharing uses the familiar Android share menu, with additional Firefox options like Send tab to device and Scan QR code. Earlier Android versions keep the existing share screen.

-Fixed an issue where inactive tabs were also being closed when all active tabs were selected for closing.
